name: Trident of Fish Command

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Dominate Beast
powers.text: 1 charge: cast Dominate Beast (save DC 15) on a Beast that has a Swim Speed.

summary: 3 charges: cast Dominate Beast (DC 15) on a Beast with a Swim Speed.
text: A magic trident holding 3 charges. As long as you carry it, 1 charge lets you cast Dominate Beast from it with a save DC of 15, targeting only a Beast with a Swim Speed. Each dawn it recovers 1d3 spent charges.
